name: VANDIRA Personal Political Context
purpose: Maintain a user-controlled working context so VANDIRA can preserve continuity across questions without guessing personal attributes.
storage: local-first browser storage; no server-side persistence in this step
privacy_rules: profile PII is not included in AI context
do not infer sensitive personal attributes
user must explicitly save persistent consultant notes
recent turns are bounded and sanitized
continuity_rules: carry selected constituency only when explicitly selected or resolved
carry established facts as user-provided context, not as authoritative election facts
pending questions inform next research plan
current/latest claims still require fresh evidence
guardrails: Never treat user notes as verified election facts without source validation
Never use sensitive personal data for political targeting
Never convert 2024 Lok Sabha segment data into 2024 Assembly results
Never persist profile phone/name into consultant AI context
